# اُسْتُحْسِنَا (ustuḥsinā) /us.tuħ.si.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
# اُسْتُحْسِنَّا (ustuḥsinnā) /us.tuħ.sin.naː/:
